scope: Execution wrappers captured while the registered assessment was running. These are provenance snapshots, not new experimental sources or additional controllers. The launcher reserves the original private pool; do not rerun it to resume.
reporting_note: The follow-through wrapper waits for completion and runs frozen saved-data analysis, figures, original retained examples and execution accounting. On partial reporting failure, preserve records and resume the specific failed stage after review instead of rerunning its immutable bookkeeping.
